value.body: A localisation specialist makes a product feel native in another language — translating and adapting app screens, games, websites, help content and marketing, and testing that the result reads and displays correctly. Localisation companies, software and game studios, and e-commerce firms hire for it.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Degree in the language, or strong certified proficiency

items.label: Common tools
items.value: CAT tools, localisation platforms, spreadsheets, bug trackers

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often join as linguistic testers (language QA) or junior translators at localisation companies, after a language test.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Attention to detail in short UI text

value.title: At a glance
items: Indian languages are also localised heavily, not only foreign ones.
Machine translation is common in this work; review and quality checking are core tasks.
Growth leads to localisation project management or language lead roles.

competition.note: BA (all subjects) graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
competition.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 34 (programme-wise out-turn), Ministry of Education
